purpose: Apply the existing P local-distribution refinement principle to frozen DOPE; compare paired DOPE/D/P, including unfavorable outcomes. Existing YOLO results are historical controls.
authorized_scope: User 2026-10-01: run experiments to complete IEEE Sensors manuscript; later instruction authorizes new head training beyond the earlier diagnosis-only document.

input.preprocessing: stage0 reflect100 resizeback to native size, shortest-side400 floor-to-eight raster; exact actual x/y inverse
input.source: Existing prepared images already include reflect100, no second reflection
input.real: Original BGR image reflected100 then same recipe
input.decoder: Existing semantic-channel local peaks, threshold0.3; no affinity object grouping
input.features: Actual VGG post-ReLU layers17/26, 256 channels stride4 /128 channels stride8
input.precision: DOPE FP32, features FP16 roundtrip as in original P; heads FP32, no AMP
input.box: Hull of at least three valid predicted corners, frozen for all methods
input.missing: Preserve missing mask and center8; no target imputation

training.usable: TRAIN only, predicted hull IoU>=0.5 with sole source GT, at least one jointly valid corner; actual sampled support counted separately at each loss
training.order: Per-seed deterministic shuffled usable rows, 6000x16; D and P same exact row sequence
training.source_supervision: Same source RGB and labels as historical YOLO, new baseline-specific usable mask disclosed
training.augmentation: No extra augmentation; identical prepared source images
training.feature_storage: No full spatial feature cache: only prediction metadata cached. Online frozen VGG prefix, no DOPE stage-head recomputation during head training
training.checkpoint: Final step6000 only; resume exact checkpoint state allowed after infrastructure interruption; no outcome-driven restart

calibration.objective: mean per-frame supported-line CE, individually per arm/seed

selection.objective: mean frame capped original-diagonal-normalized8corner error, then average3seeds; unmatched GT/missing predictions fail with1

selection_detail: P calibration: supported-frame point-target CE. D has no temperature. Same source-only lambda/cap grid and ties as YOLO. Decode displacement to original pixels before optional image-diagonal cap (nonuniform scale).

evaluation.primary: Per-estimator paired before/after 2D errors; all-GT PCK and failures plus canonical complete-point conditional medians
evaluation.downstream: Existing canonical geometry-derived reference, K/dimensions/PnP unchanged; coverage and failures retained
evaluation.unit: session, same resampled frames and seed mean
evaluation.negative_AP: Not measured for new DOPE extension; no claim

runtime.images: first two by manifest order per session, 26 total
runtime.scope: Decoded BGR through canonical pose where available; report keypoints-only separately; exclude file decoding/loading

smoke: Before main training, two optimizer updates per arm on a fixed first-four-per-source-shape group; discarded fresh smoke heads, separate seed20261001; contracts/finite gradients only, no performance selection
stopping: Exactly six fixed-budget fits. Numerical/contract bugs require documented correction. No architecture/seed/real-based threshold search.
disk_policy: Keep original artifacts; new compact caches only. Do not delete unrelated files.
historical_goal: Stable simultaneous real translation/rotation improvement remains unproven; this experiment cannot retroactively pass its fixed gates.
